write_effect: Create one new binary file from a verified immutable revision; never replace or delete
write_provisioning: Separate reviewed write_enabled grant. Encrypted write_folder, account_label, folder_label; folder must be authorized to the app. Same Drive permissionId; no implicit expansion of readonly grants.
scope: Per user/company, direct authorized folders only; CSV/XLSX item,amount_cents
provisioning: AgentDocumentConnection disabled by default. Encrypted private_config: token, identity (Drive permissionId), folders. expires_at and version required. No assistant credentials.
